- Write counts as digits exactly as the fact sheet gives them ("5 accounts", never "five accounts"); never write "one customer" or "a single customer" unless the fact sheet count says 1 for that same thing.

Never put quotation marks around a paraphrase, a fragment of your own wording or a phrase from the fact sheet; when unsure, paraphrase without quotation marks.

- Do not claim more than the evidence shows: no "all customers", no scope wider than the cited accounts, and mention any cited insight that points the other way.
- Do not recommend a solution.
</rules>

## Problem

Users cannot copy existing access roles, so every new team member needs permissions selected manually, one box at a time. The work is slow and error-prone, and a single missed permission can lock a handler out of their claims tasks [i:0ddd15842f1a5994] [i:1a7f26418b6c0389] [i:33fc05afe6e0e6bc]. The same gap shows up as a bottleneck in permission setup duplication [i:64212787cb06325c] [i:f953be575a4c6d0f].

## Who is affected

- 9 accounts have raised this, across 16 mentions and 3 routes [i:0534737a19c02875] [i:225a345befb5ae5f] [i:263f3fed3c88cf7a].
- Support route: 9 mentions, including Duncastle Auto, Ashcombe Property Mutual, Wexmoor Motor, Brackwater Homecover and Quillon Business Insurance [i:0534737a19c02875] [i:0ddd15842f1a5994] [i:ef8656968a228702] [i:5a6ac7b0f2330487] [i:f953be575a4c6d0f].
- Onboarding route: 6 mentions, including Tidewell Marine & Cargo, Kilnsey Household and Selsby Motor [i:263f3fed3c88cf7a] [i:30a47567344a2fb2] [i:992f29b2be4fdf2a].
- Sales route: 1 mention, from Hollinbrook Home Insurance, who asked how roles are assigned during setup after previous permission issues [i:225a345befb5ae5f].
- Combined ARR across these accounts is £6865000.0, with 3 renewals in the next 90 days [i:0ddd15842f1a5994] [i:1a7f26418b6c0389] [i:263f3fed3c88cf7a].

## Evidence

- Ashcombe Property Mutual reports that each user needs dozens of boxes ticked manually and that missing one locks them out, describing permission setup duplication as slowing them down [i:0ddd15842f1a5994] [i:795e6398b711b1eb].
- Wexmoor Motor says roles cannot be copied, permissions must be assigned manually, and one mistake blocks a user entirely; the same account calls the permissions system tedious and error-prone [i:1a7f26418b6c0389] [i:cc11f1f67cd8581e] [i:ef8656968a228702].
- Kilnsey Household wants to copy access roles rather than rebuild them from scratch, and describes clicking through every box for each person as exhausting with fear of locking someone out by accident [i:30a47567344a2fb2] [i:bd73221abbc1dcb1].
- Selsby Motor says every new team member means manually selecting permissions one by one, with lockout until corrected, and dreads the permissions setup because it is easy to miss a box [i:33fc05afe6e0e6bc] [i:992f29b2be4fdf2a].
- Tidewell Marine & Cargo says assigning permissions takes forever with a custom setup per person, and that copying an existing role would save hours every week [i:263f3fed3c88cf7a] [i:f01ec1502966213d].
- Quillon Business Insurance calls permission setup duplication a real bottleneck, with one slip locking someone out of their claims tasks [i:64212787cb06325c] [i:f953be575a4c6d0f].
- Duncastle Auto reports trouble assigning roles to new team members on the claims dashboard [i:0534737a19c02875].
- Brackwater Homecover reports the letters tab greyed out and an inability to assign new tasks because roles are not syncing properly [i:5a6ac7b0f2330487].
- Hollinbrook Home Insurance raised permissions during a sales conversation, asking to see how roles are assigned during setup [i:225a345befb5ae5f].

## Why now

- 3 of these accounts renew within 90 days, including Ashcombe Property Mutual on 2026-11-30, Hollinbrook Home Insurance on 2027-01-15 and Quillon Business Insurance on 2027-01-20 [i:0ddd15842f1a5994] [i:225a345befb5ae5f] [i:f953be575a4c6d0f].
- The 9 accounts involved represent £6865000.0 in ARR, and the 16 mentions span support, sales and onboarding [i:0534737a19c02875] [i:225a345befb5ae5f] [i:263f3fed3c88cf7a].
- Onboarding mentions from 2026-09-16 and 2026-09-22 show the issue is raised before go-live, while support mentions through 2026-10-25 show it persists after [i:30a47567344a2fb2] [i:33fc05afe6e0e6bc] [i:0ddd15842f1a5994].

</previous_draft>
